routing.title: Routing
routing.flowBody: When a message arrives, the planner reads it and turns it into a small set of tasks (for example: generate an image, then summarize it as audio). Each task is handled by the right capability and the results are combined into one reply.
routing.customCalloutBody: Want your own topics and system prompts? Create and edit them on the Task Prompts page — the planner picks them up automatically.
routing.masterDesc: Route messages through the planner so one request can trigger several tasks at once. When off, the legacy single-topic AI sorter handles routing instead.
routing.masterHint: Global default for the workspace. Existing users keep their own setting until they opt in; turning this on here also enables it for your own account.
routing.personalOverrideWarning: Your account still has a personal override (effective: {effective}) that differs from the workspace default ({global}).
routing.masterUpdateFailed: Failed to update multi-task routing state.
routing.plannerDesc: The instructions the planner follows to break a request into tasks. The preview shows the exact text the model receives, including your live capabilities and topics.
routing.plannerAdminRequired: Admin access required to edit the planner prompt.
routing.plannerModelDesc: Choose which AI model breaks complex requests into task cards. Switch to a different model if your default is unavailable (e.g. rate-limited).
routing.plannerModelFallbackHint: No planner model selected — the planner uses your Sorting model.
routing.legacyDesc: The single-topic AI sorter prompt, used when multi-task routing is off.
routing.fallbackSubtitle: The single-topic AI sorter prompt, used when multi-task routing is off. Admin only.

sortingPrompt.title: Preprocessor
sortingPrompt.description: The preprocessor handles the incoming message. It gets the message as a JSON object and returns a JSON object.
sortingPrompt.promptEditorLink: to change existing prompts OR add new prompts
sortingPrompt.mainTitle: Set BTOPIC and Agents in JSON
sortingPrompt.mainDescription: Define the intention of the user with every request. You will have the history, but put your focus on the new message.
sortingPrompt.jsonDescription: The JSON object is the form we save your request into the database.
sortingPrompt.jsonNote: The whole object is passed to the preprocessor. The preprocessor can change the object and return it to the central process. The central process will save the changed object into the database.
sortingPrompt.jsonExample: Here is an example of the JSON object:
sortingPrompt.btopicNote: The preprocessor can also return a new JSON object. That is setting the topic and by that, directing the message to a specific prompt. The BTOPIC is the name of YOUR TARGET prompt!
sortingPrompt.adminRequired: Admin access required to edit the sorting prompt.

get.title: Get Synaplan Desktop
get.description: A small app for macOS, Windows and Linux. It pairs with your Synaplan account and runs the skills you install on your own computer — for example building a presentation from your notes.
get.betaNote: Beta builds are not signed yet, so your operating system may ask you to confirm the first start. The repository also explains how to build the app yourself.

get.step2: Click “Pair this computer” here and copy the address and the code.
